value: Conventional commits: fix:, feat:, docs:, test:, refactor:. Version tags (v1.9.0) on release commits. Keep subject under 70 chars, use body for detail. NO footers or attribution trailers (Co-Authored-By, "Generated with ...") in commits, issue bodies, or PR descriptions — agent tooling that injects these by default must strip them. Rationale: token efficiency, not attribution policy — footers are boilerplate every future agent re-reads in git log and issue threads; keep commit/issue bodies lean the same way entries follow conventions.seedDensity.
